thread:
ravi.finance: Heads up  Solaris Devices submitted a chargeback request. Invoice INV-5220 shows reserved commit lines but billing shows zero committed usage for May. They want either corrected invoice or a credit before EOM.
jess.ops: Can we get the provisioning audit and the metering snapshot?
billing-bot: Invoice INV-5220: https://invoices.redwood/INV-5220.pdf
billing-bot: Metering summary: committed_hours=0, burst_tokens=750,320, reserved_tag=present, tag_applied_at=2026-05-02T01:05:22Z, billing_snapshot=2026-05-02T00:50:00Z
omar.sales: Contract CN-SOLAR-3G shows reserved start 2026-05-01 00:00 UTC; provisioning was expected auto at midnight. Could be a snapshot timing window again.
ravi.finance: Quick econ: burst billed $7,503 vs reserved expected $5,000; delta $2,503. Options: (1) retro allocate and reissue invoice (requires legal), or (2) apply operational credit ~ $2,700 and keep invoice. Need approval.
claire.revenue: Ops to confirm exact times. If tag applied at 01:05 and snapshot at 00:50, customer was technically unprovisioned at snapshot. But we need to consider SLA and churn risk.
jess.ops: Running query and pasting rows:
```
SELECT event_time, reserved_tag_state, billing_snapshot_time
FROM provisioning.audit
WHERE customer_id='cust_solaris' AND date(event_time) BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-03';
```
jess.ops: Output: event_time=2026-05-02T01:05:22Z, reserved_tag_state=active, billing_snapshot_time=2026-05-02T00:50:00Z
omar.sales: Customer message: "We were expecting reserved to apply; this breaks our internal forecast. We prefer corrected invoice or a formal ledger note."
ravi.finance: Claire, do you approve operational credit up to $3k to resolve quickly? If customer insists on corrected invoice, escalate to legal/contracts.
claire.revenue: Approve $2,800 operational credit conditional on ops adding a snapshot delay when provisioning pending and posting a short postmortem. Please include ledger note language for auditors.
ravi.finance: Please reply with "approve" to finalize. Also ops to set ETA for the guard.
omar.sales: I'll send the customer note: concise, transparent, offering credit and ledger note; will mention option to escalate for corrected invoice.
jess.ops: ETA for snapshot guard: 2026-05-07 12:00 UTC. Adding runbook and alert.
ravi.finance: Creating adjustment ADJ-2026-244 | amount: -2800 | reason: operational_credit_timing | linked_invoice: INV-5220. Billing will attach ledger note.
billing-bot: Ledger entry created: ADJ-2026-244 | customer: cust_solaris | amount: -2800 | reason: operational_credit_timing | linked_invoice: INV-5220
claire.revenue: approve
ravi.finance: Thanks team. Closing loop once runbook and postmortem link are attached.
